messages:
Maya (Growth): Hey team — need a quick check: webinar hero + 3 benchmark infographics for next Tuesday. Core ask: latency vs. cost sparkline, throughput bar with Dedicated vs Hosted, and a small ‘how it works’ mini-diagram. Can design fit all 3 sizes (social, slide, blog hero)?

Rob (Designer): Yep can do. Can you lock the final metrics? also need the Figma link and any existing brand variants. sizes: 1200x628, 1920x1080, 820x312?

Maya (Growth): Final metrics: 60% lower per-token cost (batch + kv cache), median tail latency 60ms on Dedicated, 3x throughput improvement on p4-like configs. Use the current brand palette (v-green, graphite). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/redwood-marketing-assets — see /benchmarks/webinar.

Aisha (PMM): Messaging guidance: headline must read, "Production inference at cloud scale — faster and cheaper." Subhead: "Latency-first routing, batching, and dedicated pools." For the sparkline callout, add a small note: "Measured on real-world conversational traffic (Q4 internal eval)." Keep legal-friendly: no absolute claims without footnote.

Rob (Designer): Got it. I'll mock three variants tonight. Question on diagram: mini-diagram should show routing -> cache -> gpu pool? or routing -> model variants -> fallback?

Maya (Growth): Prefer routing -> cache -> pool, with a tiny fallback path. Keep it schematic, 3 boxes max.

Diego (Creative Ops): Heads up — localization team needs editable source and text layers. Also ask for a copy-safe area for translations (esp. social sizes). Rob, can you supply .fig export + flattened PNG/JPG + SVG for the diags?

Rob (Designer): Yes — will export: fig, svg, png@2x. Naming convention: webinar_bench_hero_v1, webinar_bench_slide_v1, webinar_bench_social_v1. Will include an editable text-only file for localization.

Aisha (PMM): Brand check: use logo lockup from /assets/brand/v2, alt color palette only for dark-mode slides. No drop shadows on diags. Also ensure contrast ratio >=4.5:1 for body text.

Maya (Growth): Timeline: need first pass by EOD tomorrow, final by Monday morning. Also want 1 tweet-sized card with a short stat and CTA for signups.

Rob (Designer): EOD tomorrow for first pass — will drop comps in Figma and also upload zipped exports to the marketing drive.

JenkinsBot: file uploaded: https://storage.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar_bench_v1.zip (12.4MB) :white_check_mark:

Diego (Creative Ops): Awesome. I'll start the localization ticket and route to translation vendor once Rob confirms text layers.

Maya (Growth): Perfect. small ask: include an annotation layer in Figma that lists data sources for each chart (so legal can review quickly).

Rob (Designer): Will add an annotation frame called NOTES -> data-sources.txt inside Figma.

Aisha (PMM): If legal flags any phrasing, we might need a micro-variant: "up to 60%" vs "60%" — please keep copy modular.

Maya (Growth): Good call. Rob, add a micro-variant text field to each comp so we can A/B quickly.

Rob (Designer): Done — micro-variant field present in each frame. uploading now.

JenkinsBot: upload complete: https://storage.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar_bench_v1_review.zip (13.9MB) :eyes:

Maya (Growth): Thanks — reviewing now. Will post any copy tweaks here. :thumbsup:
